theme: An open day with a few things worth closing out.
greeting: An open afternoon in Maine, with the girls down in Florida this week. One recruiter call is already behind you, and a couple of bookings are quietly asking to be finished today.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Amin on the CIFIC role
needsAttention.detail: After this morning's call, Amin Noorani sent the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs brief and offered to talk it through further — he's waiting to hear whether you want to explore it.

needsAttention.title: December break — decide and book
needsAttention.detail: Your own book-by date for the three-week December trip with all four girls is today, and holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. Pick domestic or international and send one booking.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Open since mid-September — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week sells out early, so holding one now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Three conversations stack up tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: Scott Lazarus at Morgan Stanley at 9:30, Kevin Tracey at Deloitte at 11, then lunch with Fran — a few minutes tonight to land a point for each pays off.

schedule.title: Amin recruiter call
schedule.detail: Opportunities discussion with Noorani + Partners — behind you now

flagged.title: Anne's OECD November invite
flagged.detail: Anne Molyneux asks you to the OECD governance meeting in November and wants your read on three agenda items — a reply is owed.

resolved.title: Brunswick interviews locked in
resolved.detail: Erika Maass confirmed both Teams calls for Oct 27 — Jonathan Doorley at 10 and Christian Buss at 1:30 — after you chose the slots this morning.

acts.line: Amin's recruiter call wrapped mid-morning and the day opened up behind it.
Nothing more on the calendar today — the open hours are yours to steer.
The girls are in Florida this week, so Maine stays quiet and unhurried tonight.
